name: Tools of the Trade
summary: Tools of the Trade is an initiation mission for Horde rogues given by Mennet Carkad in the Undercity. Ordered by Lord Varimathras, agents must obtain lockpicking gear and infiltrate Ambermill to recover sensitive Kirin Tor reports detailing Dalaran's current state.

sections.title: Eyes on Ambermill
sections.body: Following the interrogation of a Kirin Tor captive, the Deathstalkers learned that vital intelligence concerning the ruins of Dalaran lies hidden in Ambermill. Silverpine Forest remains a precarious front line, and the human mages guarding the village guard their communications fiercely. Under the orders of Lord Varimathras, Deathstalker handler Mennet Carkad directs promising operatives to bypass Kirin Tor sentries and secure the Dalaran Status Report.

sections.title: The Art of the Breach
sections.body: Unlike straightforward assassinations, this mission serves as a practical proving ground in infiltration and lockpicking. Operatives are outfitted with specialized thieves' tools from Estelle Gendry before marching into hostile Kirin Tor territory. Cracking the secured chest in Ambermill demonstrates that an operative has progressed beyond raw street brutality into an indispensable espionage asset for the Forsaken.

aliases: who gives tools of the trade
faq.answer: Mennet Carkad, a master rogue of the Deathstalkers stationed in the Rogues' Quarter of the Undercity, assigns the task. The overarching mandate comes directly from Lord Varimathras, who oversees intelligence gathering for the Forsaken.

faq.q: What is the Dalaran Status Report?
faq.answer: It is a sealed Kirin Tor dispatch detailing conditions within Dalaran. Deathstalker interrogators extracted its location from an imprisoned human mage, alerting the Undercity that crucial information about their southern neighbors was vulnerable.

aliases: where do i find the documents
faq.answer: The report is secured inside a locked chest within the Kirin Tor outpost of Ambermill, located in southern Silverpine Forest.
Estelle Gendry, an outfitter in the Rogues' Quarter of the Undercity, provides the necessary thieves' tools to open the Kirin Tor's locked chest.

faq.q: Why is Dalaran important to the Forsaken right now?
faq.answer: Dalaran's surviving wizards maintain a fortified pocket behind an arcane dome right on the southern border of Silverpine Forest. The Forsaken keep careful tabs on their movements, strength, and defensive readiness to protect their own holdings in Lordaeron.

faq.q: What prerequisite must be completed before taking this mission?
faq.answer: Operatives must first complete the assassination contract Fenwick Thatros, hunting down a target in Silverpine Forest before Mennet Carkad trusts them with delicate infiltration work.

angles.text: This mission marks a rite of passage for Horde rogues, requiring you to procure formal lockpicking tools and apply stealth and finesse rather than brute force.
Infiltrating Ambermill allows the Forsaken to outwit the very Kirin Tor mages who seek to reclaim Lordaeron from the grave.
Securing human intelligence in Silverpine solidifies the Horde's foothold across northern Lordaeron against remnants of the Alliance.
